features.title: Lean back into complete support
features.text: The high backrest is designed to gently support your entire upper body. Whether you’re sitting up or leaning back, it helps you feel stable, relaxed and fully held—just the way comfort should feel.

features.title: Rest your arms, the right way
features.text: With broad, rounded armrests shaped for natural posture, your arms can rest comfortably in an ergonomic position—making reading, chatting, or simply relaxing feel easy and effortless.

features.title: Style with a subtle curve
features.text: A waterfall edge adds a refined curve to the seat front, softening the silhouette while elevating the visual appeal of your living space. It’s design that feels as good as it looks.

features.title: Lifted for ease, grounded in care
features.text: Elevated PVC legs make cleaning beneath the sofa easy, helping you maintain a tidier home. Sturdy and discreet, they add functionality without taking away from the elegant graphite grey fabric.

features.title: Built strong, made to last
features.text: Underneath the softness lies a durable pine wood frame and moisture-resistant plywood—giving you a solid, dependable foundation that’s crafted for years of everyday comfort.
